page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor with an x86_64 architecture and a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Because it lacks local storage, all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. The high memory density relative to the low vCPU count makes this instance a cost-efficient option for workloads that require significant memory capacity without demanding high parallel compute power. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive applications, small database caching layers, and lightweight enterprise applications.

The resource allocation profile is designed for cost-efficient deployment of memory-sensitive workloads that do not require extensive parallel processing. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention.
